name: screen-align
title: Screen Align
description: Align two displays precisely with on-screen rulers. Nudge the arrangement offset in points or millimeters, snap to tops, bottoms, centers or true physical continuity, and save layouts per display set.
author: vitbashy

commands.name: arrange
commands.title: Arrange Displays
commands.subtitle: Screen Align
commands.description: Nudge, align and swap your displays, with a live read-out in points and millimeters.

commands.name: rulers
commands.title: Show Display Rulers
commands.subtitle: Screen Align
commands.description: Toggle a millimeter ruler down the facing edge of every screen, with one shared reference line. Run again or press esc to close.

commands.name: layouts
commands.title: Display Layouts
commands.subtitle: Screen Align
commands.description: Save the current arrangement and restore it later, per set of connected displays.
